create.name: Jessica Dibb
create.bio:
Jessica Dibb is a breathwork and consciousness teacher who founded the Inspiration Consciousness School and Community, which has its campus and sanctuary in Owings Mills, Maryland, and also holds classes in New York City. She is its spiritual director and main teacher, and she has built its workshops, ongoing trainings and flagship Awakening course around a blend of Integrative Breathwork, the Enneagram, psychodynamic insight and contemplative teachings from several traditions.

Before teaching she trained in classical ballet and danced professionally, took up yoga and meditation at fourteen and spent four years living in an ashram. She now co-directs the Global Professional Breathwork Alliance and chairs its ethics committee, working towards shared training and ethical standards for breath practitioners, and she founded and hosts a yearly online Enneagram Global Summit. She is the author of Breathwork and Psychotherapy, published by Norton. Her groups range from evening breathing journeys and women's circles to online breathwork sessions and eight-week courses with a weekend retreat, and she also helps to organise the Silent Peace Walks.

courses.title: 8-Week Awakening (Maryland)
courses.description: The school's core class, held one evening a week for eight weeks at its Owings Mills campus, with a weekend retreat in the middle. It uses breath and inquiry to open into fuller presence, and is open to beginners and experienced practitioners alike.

courses.title: Virtual Breathwork Sessions
courses.description: Online group breathwork sessions of about two and a half hours, guided by Jessica and breathworkers trained at her school. Sessions are held on weekend afternoons several times a season.

courses.title: Integrative Breathing Journey in NYC
courses.description: An in-person afternoon of Integrative Breathwork in Manhattan, facilitated by Jessica with breathworkers from her school.

courses.title: Women's Breathing Journey
courses.description: An evening breathwork circle for women at the school's campus in Owings Mills, guided by Jessica and her breathworkers.
